theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+2.66%) and Consumer Discretionary (+1.99%) led the market today, while Utilities (+0.07%) and Consumer Staples (+0.22%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +2.21% versus +0.18% for defensives and +1.20% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +2.33% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +1.18%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +1.73%. The VIX fell 11.16% to 23.81, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.33% to $3,668.50, crude oil was little changed at $83.08, and bitcoin slipped 1.31% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
